name: Harold Whitfield
psychographics: Prioritizes reliability and quiet operation; appreciates smart alerts that help him maintain his morning toast routine without his wife's assistance
current_solutions: Hive thermostat; Bosch oven with smart probe; BBC Good Food app for weekly meal plans
frustration: At 7:45 AM on Mother's Day, his smart toaster burned the bread because the humidity sensor misread the room temperature, triggering a cancel cycle right as he was about to slice the first slice for his wife's breakfast
decision_style: sticks with trusted brands he’s used for decades; will consider a new device only if it promises to reduce his weekly chores by at least 20 minutes
voice: formal, clipped, and heavily reliant on BBC Radio 4 terminology; speaks in complete, measured sentences
